sources.title: 《桯史》卷十五〈楊艮議命〉四部叢刊傳文
sources.provider: Wikisource / Si Bu Cong Kan Xu Bian transcription
sources.quality_notes: Two narrative episodes. 1201 belongs to the Jiujiang episode; Yuan Shao’s later four-pair example is separately undated. Four pairs include Ren-Yin, with transformation and Meng-branch discussion. No hour-stem derivation stated. The 1934 postface states a Yuan attribution for the exemplar.

sources.title: 《桯史》卷十五〈楊艮議命〉四庫傳文
sources.quality_notes: The same four pairs and separate episodes appear in a later received route. Independence from the attributed Yuan exemplar and original glyphs are unbound.

sources.title: CiNii BA66429129《桯史》1934年涵芬樓影印本
sources.provider: CiNii Books / National Institute of Informatics
sources.quality_notes: Commercial Press, Shanghai, 1934.1, three fascicles. Captures the stated Yuan Qushi/Tieqin Tongjianlou exemplar without independently dating that impression or identifying its current shelfmark.

sources.title: 台北国图 NCL 08345《桯史》1622长水岳氏刊本
sources.provider: National Central Library / public image locator
sources.quality_notes: First-party NCL catalog and public mirror share 310.21 08345. Catalog binds the 1622 edition and reports Yue Ke’s Jiading seventh-year preface. No collation of volume 15 in this physical copy.

sources.title: 《直斋书录解题》卷十二《信齋百中經》《怡齋百中經》
sources.quality_notes: Names anonymous Anqing exemplar and Cao Dongye’s Yizhai entry separately. Cao’s calendar criticism is reported and qualified by Chen.

sources.title: 《文献通考》卷220引陈氏两种《百中經》
sources.provider: Shidian Guji / Wenxian Tongkao received transcription
sources.quality_notes: The paired entries borrow the named Chen account. This is traceable reception, not another Song physical witness.

sources.title: 《南村辍耕录》卷二十九〈日家安命法〉
sources.quality_notes: Short title Baizhong Jing, solar lodge at birth, birth double-hour and counting to mao. Neither this abbreviated title nor downstream Ziwei identity is resolved.

sources.title: 台北国图 08360《南村輟耕錄》1474松江府刊本
sources.provider: National Central Library / public image locator
sources.quality_notes: First-party NCL catalog binds 08360, 30 juan, six fascicles, 1474 Songjiang print, with 1366 Sun Zuo preface. Target leaf in juan 29 is not collated.

sources.title: 《四库全书总目》卷111所录《百中經》与两件元明命书
sources.provider: Wikisource / received Siku catalog, cross-checked with Shidian
sources.quality_notes: Reports a 1307 colophon and 1326 preface for Ziping Sanming Yuanyuan Zhu, a 1384 postface and six categories for Cunjin Yijian, and multiple calendar layers into the Ming in the Baizhong Jing presented by Zhejiang. Dates are those of reported inscriptions, not copy or content dates.

sources.title: 嘉庆《天一閣書目》卷三《紫微斗數》一卷
sources.provider: Shidian Guji transcription / National Archives of Japan digital object
sources.quality_notes: Shidian and NAJ copy 297-0088 fifth digital fascicle locate the anonymous one-juan listing. The catalog layer supports a historical holding, with edition, exact date and present survival of the listed book unbound.

sources.title: 光绪《天一閣見存書目》卷末两件命书著录
sources.quality_notes: Two adjacent entries match the Qing catalog titles. The image index displays a note indicating reliance on an earlier catalog for the Li entry. No physical continuity with the Siku compilation as stated or current holding verified.
sources.digital_route: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tianyige-330000-1705-0009199_天一閣見存書目四卷首_末_清薛福成編次_清光緒刻本.pdf

unresolved_lineage_questions: Can the two original-edition locations of Yang Gen’s passage be identified and compared without treating the 1201 narrative date as Yuan Shao’s date?
Which of the two Song Baizhong Jing titles, if either, underlies the particular procedure quoted by Tao?
What evidence binds the Yuan colophon, preface, near-title Korean holdings, and received Yuanhai Ziping to their own exemplars?
Can the Cunjin Yijian postface and six-category text be dated independently and the Tianyige physical copies identified?
